cognitive_sessions_phase_cooldown_invari.name: cognitive_sessions_phase_cooldown_invariant
cognitive_sessions_phase_cooldown_invari.value: ("cognitive_sessions"."phase" = 'COOLDOWN' AND "cognitive_sessions"."cooldown_until" IS NOT NULL) OR ("cognitive_sessions"."phase" <> 'COOLDOWN' AND "cognitive_sessions"."cooldown_until" IS NULL)

execution_operations_unknown_uncertainty.name: execution_operations_unknown_uncertainty_invariant
execution_operations_unknown_uncertainty.value: ("execution_operations"."status" = 'UNKNOWN' AND "execution_operations"."uncertainty_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("execution_operations"."status" <> 'UNKNOWN' AND "execution_operations"."uncertainty_reason" IS NULL)

executions_status_timestamp_invariant.name: executions_status_timestamp_invariant
executions_status_timestamp_invariant.value: ("executions"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "executions"."started_at" IS NULL AND "executions"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("executions"."status" = 'RUNNING' AND "executions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "executions"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "executions"."safety_generation_at_start" IS NOT NULL) OR ("executions"."status" IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND "executions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("executions"."status" = 'BLOCKED' AND "executions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "executions"."error" IS NOT NULL)

execution_safety_state_status_fields_inv.name: execution_safety_state_status_fields_invariant
execution_safety_state_status_fields_inv.value: ("execution_safety_state"."durable_status" = 'UNAUTHORIZED' AND "execution_safety_state"."failure_code" IS NULL AND "execution_safety_state"."blocked_at" IS NULL) OR ("execution_safety_state"."durable_status" = 'BLOCKED' AND "execution_safety_state"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL AND "execution_safety_state"."blocked_at" IS NOT NULL)

execution_safety_state_evaluation_refs_a.name: execution_safety_state_evaluation_refs_all_or_none
execution_safety_state_evaluation_refs_a.value: ("execution_safety_state"."evaluated_candidate_id" IS NULL AND "execution_safety_state"."grounding_result_id" IS NULL AND "execution_safety_state"."policy_decision_id" IS NULL) OR ("execution_safety_state"."evaluated_candidate_id" IS NOT NULL AND "execution_safety_state"."grounding_result_id" IS NOT NULL AND "execution_safety_state"."policy_decision_id" IS NOT NULL)

assistant_turns_completion_invariant.name: assistant_turns_completion_invariant
assistant_turns_completion_invariant.value: ("assistant_turns"."status" = 'PROCESSING' AND "assistant_turns"."assistant_message" IS NULL AND "assistant_turns"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("assistant_turns"."status" <> 'PROCESSING' AND "assistant_turns"."assistant_message" IS NOT NULL AND "assistant_turns"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
